name: A Safe Place
description: Emergency shelter, legal services, mental health support, and prevention education in the East Bay
fullDescription: A Safe Place provides comprehensive support services including emergency shelter, legal advocacy, counseling, and community education for individuals and families in the East Bay seeking safety.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24-hour emergency line
- 24-hour crisis shelter for survivors and their children
- Legal services, including help with gun violence restraining orders (GVROs)
- Community mental health services
- Teen dating violence prevention
- Community outreach and education
howToGetIt:
1. Call 24-hour emergency line: 510-536-7233 (510-536-SAFE)
2. Main office line: 510-986-8600
3. Speak with a trained advocate
4. Receive safety planning
5. Access shelter if needed
6. Connect with ongoing services
keywords: A Safe Place, Oakland, East Bay, Alameda County, crisis hotline, emergency shelter, legal advocacy, counseling, children services, 510-536-7233
